what_the_seeds_are.global_model_G: FIXED at seed 42 for ALL three seeds (shared_global_representation_is_seed42_fixed = true)
what_the_seeds_are.rng_rule: router_fold_seed(s,k) = 1000*s + k; the seed changes optimisation randomness, NOT fold membership (seed_regenerates_fold_membership = false)
what_the_seeds_are.evidence_for_g: NONE — macro_global_dice is identical to 1.36e-16 across seeds, proving G is the same checkpoint

observed_sd.measures: the sample SD of the MACRO-DOMAIN EQUAL-WEIGHT MEAN DICE DELTA across THREE INDEPENDENTLY RETRAINED DOWNSTREAM BARR STACKS (R_psi → B_phi → S_omega) evaluated on VAL808, with the global model G held fixed at seed 42.
does_not_measure: stochastic inference repeat variability (each checkpoint is deterministic)
sampling error of the evaluation set
independent replication of the global model G
observed_sd.interpretation_caution: n=3 gives 2 degrees of freedom; the SD estimate is itself extremely unstable and no confidence interval or significance test may be derived from it.

relevance_to_barr_m1.reason: BARR-M1 is a single-frozen-bundle re-analysis; the three-seed spread is cited only as historical motivation for the ±0.0006 scale of downstream training randomness, never as a BARR-M1 uncertainty estimate.
